# Alex Abian — Photography
> Dubai-based photographer: architectural, hospitality, editorial.

## About
Alex Abian is a photographer based in Dubai, UAE, specialising in architectural photography, hospitality photography (luxury hotels, resorts), editorial photography, and commercial photography. Trilingual: English, Spanish, Japanese. Previously based in Tokyo. Available worldwide.

## Gear
- Hasselblad X2D 100C (medium format, 100MP)
- Blackmagic Pocket Cinema Camera 4K / 6K
- Natural light prioritised, professional lighting supplement

## Services
- Architectural Photography — exterior, interior, aerial
- Hospitality Photography — hotel rooms, suites, spas, F&B, lifestyle
- Editorial Photography — brand campaigns, documentary
- Commercial Photography — product, corporate, advertising
- Video Production — cinematic, commercial, brand films

- **Commercial LUTs** (DaVinci Resolve) — $44 — commercial colour grading
